name: cache-clock
description: A band above the prompt counts down each prompt cache's TTL, with its hit rate and misses, says what the next message re-caches once one goes cold, and can keep the main cache warm for up to 6 hours

ttl.title: Subagent cache TTL
ttl.description: The prompt cache TTL to assume for subagents until one is seen; the main thread's is assumed 1h. A cache that serves a hit more than 5 minutes after its last request is switched to 1h on its own.
